profile.headline: Software Developer at Farmers Mutual Hail Insurance
profile.summary: Majored in Software Engineering at Iowa State University. Currently a Software Developer at Farmers Mutual Hail Insurance. I work with Spring, Hibernate, Java, JavaScript, JQuery, Bootstrap, SQL, and RESTful API. I work in an Agile environment.

positions.locationName: West Des Moines, Iowa, United States

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Improved the Company’s build server by setting up projects and writing pipeline scripts to allow for parallel build processes to run, as the prior process was sequential and slower. Worked on frontend form validation for a customer-based website using React hook forms to ensure valid user-entered information. Used agile development principles, participated in sprints, used source control, and continuous integration.

positions.title: Parks maintenance
positions.description: Collaborated with teammates to maintain nearly 400 acres of parks for the City of Fairmont during the summers. Operated City of Fairmont vehicles and equipment to contribute to the upkeep and care of the grounds, facilities, parks, athletic fields, and other community property.

positions.title: Pro Shop employee
positions.description: Supervised the course store and managed golf tee times to ensure member satisfaction and retention. Trusted to maintain member’s golf clubs and carts. Coordinated with teammates and superiors to organize various golf tournaments.
